decisions.executionNote: Initiate elbow-up left-arm approach with open gripper; left tube is diagonal and will need yaw alignment.
Continue left approach with smaller joint-continuous increments while aligning to the diagonal tube.
Align downward fingers above the left tube body, keeping a small vertical clearance before grasping.
Refine capward alignment from wrist RGB, descend 2 cm, and close around the left tube body.
Lift the closed left grasp clear of the tabletop and verify tube retention before transport.
Transport retained left tube toward the rack while gradually turning it upright; keep elbow-up continuity.
Continue gradual reorientation above the left rack slots; retain the tube with closed gripper.
Finish turning the first tube upright and approach the front-left rack opening from above.
Align over the left front opening and lower the upright tube slowly, retaining the grasp while checking insertion alignment.
Seat the first tube with a short final descent, then open the gripper so it can settle into the slot.
The first tube is released upright in the rack. Retract the left hand while initiating an elbow-up approach to the inner right tube.
Return left arm toward its origin while approaching the inner right tube with a gradual downward-grasp orientation.
Align the inner right tube along the open fingers and descend to a pregrasp height; finish returning the left arm home.
Descend around the centered inner right tube and close the right gripper, leaving the first inserted tube untouched.
Lift the second tube away from the table with a closed right gripper; check that the tube remains retained before reorientation.
Transport the retained second tube toward the right rack opening while gradually rotating upright, keeping clearance above the rack.
Continue the smooth right-arm rotation and approach above the rightmost open rack slot; the second tube remains between the fingers.
Finish bringing the second tube upright over the rightmost front slot; maintain closed grip and vertical clearance.
Lower the upright second tube into the rightmost front opening, with a small orientation correction and the gripper kept closed.
Seat the second tube with a short final descent, then release it into the rack and inspect its stability.
Withdraw the open right gripper upward and backward from the second inserted tube before approaching the remaining tube.
Move through a raised right-side waypoint and start rotating the open gripper toward the remaining diagonal tube.
Continue the right-side approach, bringing the downward grasp toward the last tube while staying clear of the rack.
Complete the downward orientation and move above the last tube body with the right gripper open.
Make the final small alignment and descent, then close around the third tube without disturbing the two inserted tubes.
Lift the last tube with the right gripper closed and verify retention before moving toward the center rack slot.
Carry the retained third tube inward within the right workspace while starting a gradual turn upright above the rack.
Continue carrying the third tube toward the center opening while rotating upright with clearance over the two inserted tubes.
Finish turning the last tube upright over the center slot, adding height to clear the neighboring inserted tube.
Lower the upright third tube toward the center opening with a small lateral correction, retaining it until seated.
Refine the center-slot alignment and continue a slow insertion, keeping the gripper closed until the tube is seated.
Complete the short seating descent for the third tube, then open the right gripper to let it settle upright in the center slot.
All three tubes appear released upright. Withdraw the right hand clear of the rack and refine the left arm's home pose.
Three tubes remain upright in the rack. Return the empty right arm toward origin with a continuous elbow-up motion.
